title: Productivity suite user, sign-in and device settings
what_it_shows: Business plan in the shop's name with one user account (the owner, administrator); MFA on with text-message codes sent to the owner's phone, the only registered second factor; connected devices are the shop laptop and the owner's phone; the provider keeps sign-in and sharing event history, and no saved or exported review of it exists

title: Productivity suite sharing, retention and restore settings
what_it_shows: New sharing links default to "anyone with the link" and have no expiry; deleted items and prior file versions are kept 30 days on this plan; the Jobs folder holds customer drawings, CAM files, NC programs, inspection reports and quotes and is synced to the laptop; the activity history shows no file or version restore

title: Productivity suite plan terms and trust portal page
source_system: Productivity suite provider website and trust portal
what_it_shows: Business plan terms; the provider publishes a SOC 2 Type 2 report to business customers through its trust portal; no copy had been downloaded by the shop; the owner requested it through the portal on 2026-08-03

title: Accounting SaaS user list and security settings
what_it_shows: Two users: the owner (administrator) and the bookkeeper (accountant role, a named login that signs in through the CPA firm's own account with MFA); the owner's administrator account signs in with a password only, and MFA is available and turned off; bank feed connected; card payments go through the provider's hosted payment page; automatic transaction categorization is turned on

title: Accounting SaaS sales by customer report, 2025-08-01 to 2026-07-31
what_it_shows: About 12 active business customers and no consumers; three medical device OEMs about 65% of receipts, the aerospace supplier about 20%, and about eight local commercial and industrial customers about 15%; invoices raised weekly on net-30 terms

title: 2025 Schedule C (Form 1040)
source_system: Owner's tax files (prepared by the CPA firm)
what_it_shows: Gross receipts of about $180,000; no wages paid; the business is a sole proprietorship with no employees

title: Business bank and card statements, 2025-08-01 to 2026-07-31
source_system: Business bank account and card statements
what_it_shows: Recurring payments to the productivity suite provider, the accounting SaaS provider, the website builder, the CAM software vendor, the internet provider, the phone carrier, the alarm monitoring company, the general liability insurer and the landlord; hourly payments to the IT technician; monthly payments to the CPA firm; payments to the heat treater, the anodizer, the calibration lab and the machine tool dealer; a laptop purchase in 2025; no payment for a backup service, a cyber insurance policy, a security course, or the AI assistant

title: Shop laptop settings review
what_it_shows: One local user account, with administrator rights, used for all work; built-in full-disk encryption on; built-in antivirus with real-time protection on; automatic OS updates on and update history current; host firewall on; CAD/CAM software with an online license check, two releases behind the vendor's current release; the Jobs folder syncs from the productivity suite; a shared folder that the VMC reads programs from; the IT technician's remote-support tool installed with unattended access on; no backup software other than the sync client

title: Mobile phone settings and content review
what_it_shows: Personal phone used for business; passcode and device encryption on; automatic updates on; business email app signed in; receives the productivity suite's text-message codes; camera roll holds setup and finished-part photos; customer text threads; used as a hotspot

title: Router connected-device list and Wi-Fi settings
what_it_shows: Router supplied by the internet provider; one Wi-Fi network and no guest network; connected devices include the laptop, the phone, the VMC, the alarm panel and several unnamed devices; the owner holds no record of a router admin password change or a firmware update

title: Bay walk-through
what_it_shows: Bay and office doors on keyed locks with a monitored alarm panel; the Wi-Fi password is posted on the office wall; customer drawings on the inspection bench and setup sheets at the machines are in view from the entrance; paper travelers and inspection records in a locked cabinet; no visitor sign-in sheet or escort notice at the door; unlabeled USB sticks at the turning center mixed with personal sticks; the laptop retired in 2025, which still holds old job files, and used USB sticks in the office desk drawer; the VMC network cable runs to the router

title: Bay lease and alarm monitoring agreement
what_it_shows: 1,800-square-foot bay with an office corner in a Florida light-industrial building; the owner holds the keys and the landlord keeps a master key; monitored intrusion alarm with a monitoring company

title: VMC controller information screen and machine builder support notice
source_system: VMC controller (SYS-05); machine builder notice in the inbox
what_it_shows: VMC controller from 2012 on an embedded operating system; the builder's notice states the controller software no longer receives updates; the network port receives programs from the laptop's shared folder; the controller manual describes no log of program edits made at the panel; the turning center loads programs from a USB stick and has no network connection

title: Jobs folder and traveler review for released OEM programs
what_it_shows: About 180 released programs for the three OEMs are kept in the Jobs folder by customer and part, editable from the laptop, with no separate read-only copy or file hash; released programs are also held in VMC controller memory; the sampled travelers record no program edits made at the controller

title: Customer agreements: NDAs, supplier quality agreements and PO quality clauses
source_system: Signed agreements folder; OEM supplier portals (SYS-07)
what_it_shows: NDAs with all three OEMs and the aerospace customer; supplier quality agreements with two OEMs; the third OEM uses PO quality clauses and its NDA asks for prompt notice; the agreements require first article inspection reports, certificates of conformance, material traceability to the heat lot, quality records kept 10 years, prior written approval of process changes to released parts (including CNC program changes), and notice within 5 business days of any unauthorized access to OEM confidential information

title: Aerospace customer purchase orders, 2025-03 to 2026-07
what_it_shows: POs since 2025-03 flow down FAR 52.204-21 and FAR 52.204-25; PO terms require notice of any cyber incident affecting the customer's information within 72 hours; DFARS 252.204-7012 does not appear in the PO terms

title: Aerospace customer supplier letter on CMMC Level 1
what_it_shows: Letter dated 2026-06-15: the customer is a tier-2 machined-assembly supplier on a DoD prime contract; its new DoD subcontract carries DFARS 252.204-7021 at CMMC Level 1 (Self); the shop must hold a Final Level 1 (Self) status with an affirmation in SPRS before the next PO award, expected in December 2026; the customer's drawings contain FCI but no CUI and no ITAR-controlled technical data; DFARS 252.204-7012 is not flowed down

title: Customer portal account pages
source_system: Aerospace file-exchange portal and two OEM supplier portals (SYS-07)
what_it_shows: Named account on the aerospace customer's secure file-exchange portal, where the customer enforces MFA; named accounts on two OEM supplier portals used for POs, first article uploads and corrective action requests

title: SAM.gov entity search and SPRS access check
source_system: SAM.gov public entity search; owner's files
what_it_shows: No SAM.gov registration and no CAGE code for the shop; no PIEE or SPRS account; no CMMC self-assessment record

title: Search of the owner's files for security documents
source_system: Laptop; productivity suite files; email; paper files
what_it_shows: No written security policy, risk assessment, incident plan or contact list, review of the FAR 52.204-21 requirements, list of approved external systems, drawing intake screening rule, retention rule for security records, disposal record, emergency access sheet, device list, or security training certificate was found

title: Outside processor POs and email threads
what_it_shows: POs to the heat treater, the anodizer and the calibration lab carry no confidentiality or FAR 52.204-21 terms; no NDA with any processor; the email threads with the anodizer include aerospace drawing attachments and "anyone with the link" sharing links

title: IT technician NDA and invoices, 2025-08 to 2026-07
what_it_shows: NDA signed by the IT technician on 2026-08-07; hourly invoices for laptop, router and machine network help, including remote sessions on the laptop; no written security terms with the technician before the NDA

title: Bookkeeper engagement letter
what_it_shows: Monthly bookkeeping and tax returns by the CPA firm through its own named login to the accounting SaaS with the accountant role

title: Machine tool dealer service report
what_it_shows: Annual preventive maintenance on the VMC; the service technician connected his own service laptop to the VMC controller during the visit

title: OEM supplier audit reports
what_it_shows: Reports from two OEM supplier audits in the past 12 months, the later dated 2026-05-20; each records an on-site visit to the bay by the OEM's auditor

title: General liability policy declarations
what_it_shows: General liability coverage in force for 2026; no cyber coverage or cyber endorsement is listed on the declarations page

title: OEM email on a spoofed bank-change request
what_it_shows: In 2026-05 an OEM accounts payable clerk received a spoofed email asking for payment to "new bank details"; the OEM called the shop to check and nothing was paid

title: Website builder account settings
what_it_shows: One account (the owner) can edit and publish; contact page and a photo gallery of past work; hosted on the website builder's platform, outside the shop network

title: AI assistant account settings and chat list
what_it_shows: Free consumer plan in the owner's name, opened in 2026-03; about 40 chats since then, titled by topic (quotes, customer emails, GD&T callouts, G-code); the setting that allows chats to be used to improve the vendor's models is on

title: Productivity suite provider SOC 2 Type 2 report
what_it_shows: Type 2 report on the Security, Availability and Confidentiality categories for the 12 months ending 2026-03-31; unqualified opinion; no exceptions noted; colocation data center providers carved out; lists complementary user entity controls (users and MFA, sharing settings, own backups, log review, reporting suspected compromise); deleted items and versions kept 30 days on this plan

title: BIA self-review worksheet
source_system: Owner-machinist's written BIA worksheet, reviewed with the IT technician
what_it_shows: For each of the five business functions, the owner's account of the systems, vendors and customers involved, the manual workaround, and the longest outage and data loss the function can tolerate; the machines keep running released programs from controller memory; the owner is the only person who performs or authorizes each function

title: Risk walk-through of the laptop, router, machines and accounts
what_it_shows: Where drawings and programs sit day to day (Jobs folder, laptop, VMC memory, USB sticks, email, AI chats); how programs move to the VMC over the network and to the turning center by USB stick; how the service technician's laptop and the IT technician's remote sessions reach the shop's equipment; bank-detail changes are not verified by phone

title: Gap analysis self-review
source_system: Owner-machinist's written answers to the FAR 52.204-21, CMMC and CSF questions, checked on screen with the IT technician
what_it_shows: Account lists checked on screen 2026-08-11 show the owner and the bookkeeper only; the bookkeeper login was added on request with no written approval; the owner reuses two passwords and has no password manager; used USB sticks are thrown away as they are; the owner asks the OEM before planned program changes; the FAR 52.204-21 clause had not been reviewed since 2025-03; the FAR 52.204-25 reporting duty is not written anywhere; the 5-business-day notice term in the two SQAs had not been read; no risk tolerance, review cycle, incident declaration criteria or customer recovery messages exist; the parts contain no telecommunications equipment

title: Sharing link report and sent-items search
source_system: Productivity suite sharing report and email sent items (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: 27 "anyone with the link" shares open, some more than a year old, including 4 aerospace drawing packages sent to the anodizer; the sent items show aerospace drawing packages emailed to the anodizer with no flowdown terms in the messages

title: Control assessment: Boundary protection test
source_system: Router settings and admin page; network walk-through; share test from a phone on the shop Wi-Fi; external port check
what_it_shows: No one monitors the router and logging is off; the external port check showed no open inbound ports; a phone joined to the shop Wi-Fi opened the VMC program share on the laptop with no password; the laptop, VMC, alarm panel and visitors share one network; the router admin password was the factory default printed on its label and the firmware had never been updated (password changed during the test); no publicly accessible component is hosted in the shop

title: Control assessment: Backup and restore test
source_system: Productivity suite plan settings; restore of a deleted program file from file versions; laptop configuration review
what_it_shows: A deleted program file was restored from the 30-day versions; the synced Jobs folder is the only copy, reachable from the laptop; CAM post-processors, tool libraries and machine settings on the laptop have no backup; security and quality documents sit in the same synced folder; the provider encrypts and protects stored versions (SOC 2 report)

title: Control assessment: Program integrity compare
source_system: Laptop secure boot and OS integrity settings; released-program folder review; compare of 10 OEM programs in VMC memory with the Jobs folder copies
what_it_shows: Secure boot on and the OS verifies signed system files and updates; no tool checks released NC programs for changes; 2 of the 10 OEM programs in VMC memory differed from the Jobs folder copy (feed-rate and offset edits made at the controller and not recorded on the traveler), and the parts made with them passed inspection; no action is defined for a program that does not match its released copy

title: Control assessment: External systems review
source_system: Email sent items; AI assistant chat history; bookkeeper engagement letter; customer portal terms; owner self-review
what_it_shows: The bookkeeper reaches the accounting SaaS from the CPA firm's systems under the engagement letter; customer portals are used under the customers' terms; customer drawing content was entered in the consumer AI assistant and aerospace drawings were emailed to the anodizer; no external system is listed as approved or prohibited

title: Control assessment: Administrator MFA sign-in test
source_system: Productivity suite and accounting SaaS security pages; sign-in tests from a new browser
what_it_shows: The productivity suite administrator sign-in required a text-message code; the accounting SaaS administrator signed in with a password only

title: Control assessment: Remote-support tool review
source_system: Remote-support tool settings on the laptop; owner self-review
what_it_shows: Unattended access on the remote-support tool was on and the owner turned it off during the test; the tool is the only remote access to the laptop and the owner installed it for the IT technician; no written usage restrictions or session guidance exist

title: Control assessment: Visitor records walk-through
source_system: Walk-through of the bay door and office; owner self-review
what_it_shows: No visitor log exists; two OEM auditors, the machine service technician and delivery drivers visited in the past year; no one is named to receive reports of visitor anomalies

title: Control assessment: Media drawer inventory
what_it_shows: The retired laptop (about to be traded in) and 6 used USB sticks were in the office drawer; no sanitization method or disposal record exists; used sticks have been thrown away as they are

title: Control assessment: Public content review
source_system: Website gallery and social media page; owner self-review
what_it_shows: Only the owner can post to the website and social media; a gallery photo of a finished aerospace part with the customer's part number visible, posted in 2026-04, was found and removed the same day; no review before posting and no periodic content review exist

title: Control assessment: Malicious code protection test
source_system: Antivirus status page; standard antivirus test file downloaded and copied from a USB stick
what_it_shows: The built-in antivirus detected and quarantined the test file on download and on the USB stick; signature updates install automatically (last update the same day); scheduled weekly and real-time scans on, including removable media; the alert was shown to the owner; no false positives recorded

title: AI assistant chat history review
what_it_shows: About 40 chats since 2026-03; one OEM drawing PDF uploaded in 2026-05; notes pasted from two aerospace drawings, with no aerospace drawing file uploaded; about 12 G-code snippets generated or edited, 3 of which were used on the machines after the owner edited them; no record of accuracy checks on AI output

title: AI assistant consumer terms and data settings, as accepted
source_system: AI assistant vendor website; account settings (SYS-08)
what_it_shows: Click-through consumer terms with no confidentiality commitment to business users; by default chats may be used to improve the vendor's models
